instruction: Candid action photograph, low-angle medium-full shot. On a sunny paved road next to a concrete barrier, the man with blonde-tipped dreadlocks (R1) wearing a plaid shirt and blue jeans walks forward on the left, holding a pink skateboard. On the right, the woman with blonde hair (R2) wearing a black leather jacket walks alongside him. They hold hands, moving together side-by-side under a bright blue sky with harsh sunlight casting distinct shadows on the ground.
